text:
nightly-eval-bot: nightly eval finished for model redwood-x-lite-int8 — promptset=translation_eu, failures=37/500, BLEU drop=12.4%. Full report: https://ci.redwood/internal/evals/1801234567

maria: saw the report. a lot of outputs look like punctuation spacing issues and some truncated tails.

evan: did the quant pipeline change tokenizer or spm submodule recently?

sanford: yes — when building the int8 artifact we pulled sentencepiece v1.3 from the quant-tooling submodule. prod baseline artifacts use v1.2 (we missed pinning).

olivia: can we get token diffs for a few failing prompts? i want a concrete example.

maria: here are two quick diffs from the failing set:
```
prompt: "¿Cómo te llamas?"
prod (spm v1.2) tokens -> [199, 42, 501, 223] -> detokenized: "¿Cómo te llamas?"
int8 build (spm v1.3) tokens -> [199, 42, 501, 2, 223] -> detokenized: "¿Cómo te llamas ?"
```

```
prompt: "Le prix est élevé."
prod: "Le prix est élevé."
int8: "Le prix est élevé ."
```

evan: that extra space before punctuation changes n-gram matches — BLEU is very sensitive. quantization amplified small probability changes so beam ended up selecting forms with spaced punctuation.

maria: root cause summary: tokenizer version mismatch (spm v1.3 vs v1.2) between the quantization pipeline and baseline artifacts. secondary effect: int8 calibration slightly shifted logits making the changed tokenization more likely.

sanford: mitigation plan: 1) rollback the int8 artifact we pushed last night and republish pinned build using spm v1.2 (doing now). 2) add a deterministic tokenization parity test in nightly-eval that runs 100 seed prompts across locales and fails the canary if detokenized outputs differ >1%. 3) add a pre-commit check in quant pipeline to pin sentencepiece submodule.

olivia: i've opened PR #4322 to add the parity test and the canary gating rule (link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4322). the test includes a small sample of translation_eu plus 5 other multilingual seeds.

nightly-eval-bot: scheduled canary run for parity test at ts=1801237890; will report pass/fail to #eng-ml.

maria: action items assigned: sanford -> rollback and republish pinned build; olivia -> parity test + gating PR; evan -> update the model onboarding checklist and docs to require tokenizer pinning for quant builds. target: EOD for rollback + tests green by tomorrow morning.

evan: will add a short customer-facing note summarizing impact and mitigation (we should mention that generation surface area unchanged except spacing issues).

olivia: :thumbsup: starting test run now, will post logs to the PR.
